title: Business Central 14 Reimplementation for Cloud Migration

facts.text: Business Central 14 Reimplementation tool migrates selected business data for clean start without legacy customizations.
Only supports Business Central version 14; for other versions use standard cloud migration.
Migrates master data, transactional data, opening balances, setup data, and historical data based on enabled modules.
Built-in migrators do not migrate open sales orders or purchase orders.
Legacy C/AL customizations and extension data not migrated by built-in migrators.
More than 40 migrators included for transferring defined sets of business data.
Complete preparation steps, run cloud migration setup, and select Dynamics 365 Business Central Re-implementation v.14 as Product.
Tool is open source and extensible for partners to add modules or customize transformation logic.
